messages:
samir: ops-bot just fired an alert for hosted-usw2 GPU pool — sudden queue spike and admission rejects. seeing p95 token wait climb. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/pool/hosted-usw2-skyline :rotating_light:
ops-bot: [ALERT] pool=hosted-usw2-skyline severity=high queue_len=312 p95_latency=4.2s admission_reject_rate=23% incident=INC-2026-03-20-001
jules: oncall looped in. can someone quickly check autoscaler, node provisioning, and any image-warmup tasks? if autoscaler healthy we should overflow to eu2 and lower admission throttle temporarily.
maya: checking cloud API — there is a provisioning backlog. cloud provider shows ~24 instances stuck in provisioning for the last 8m (status=provisioning_pending). likely explains why headroom didn't refill.
leo: also seeing noisy warmup job on a small subset of nodes that pinned all GPUs. snippet from kube logs:
```
I0316 21:12:03.123456 kubelet: Pod warmup-loader-62d8 cpu=0.7 gpu=100% container=loader imagePull=0ms
I0316 21:12:08.987654 kubelet: evicting pod warmup-loader-62d8 due to GPUPressure
```
That job should be in a separate warmup pool, not core serving.
samir: good catch. if warmup is in wrong pool then eviction churn reduces effective capacity. @jules can you toggle overflow while we patch warmup routing? command to toggle: `redwoodctl routing set-overflow --from=hosted-usw2-skyline --to=hosted-eu2-gpu --enable true`
jules: I'll run that now and bump admission throttle to avoid dropping in-flight requests. running: `redwoodctl admission update --pool=hosted-usw2-skyline --target-reject-threshold=40%`
ops-bot: action logged: overflow_toggle by jules at 2160005589, admission_update applied at 2160005592.
maya: also opened a ticket with cloud (TICKET-4532) to investigate provisioning delay/quotas.
leo: quick workaround — pausing the warmup job on the affected node group: `kubectl scale deploy/warmup-loader --replicas=0 -n infra-warmup` (applied)
samir: nice. patching warmup routing to use warmup-pool and scheduling constraints in infra repo now. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/1849
jules: overflow enabled, admission threshold bumped. watching metrics.
maya: queue p95 dropped to ~1.1s within 4m after overflow flip. will keep monitoring for 15m and follow up in incident doc. :white_check_mark:
samir: great job team. we'll keep incident open until cloud confirms provisioning backlog cleared. please paste any follow-ups here and tag oncall if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
